Omega · ref. 3539.50

Speedmaster Reduced

Chronograph · 39mm · 30m–100m · automatic · 1996–2026

A smaller, automatic version of the iconic Speedmaster, the Reduced offers the classic chronograph design in a more compact 39mm case. It is defined by its automatic movement with a modular chronograph, making it a practical choice for daily wear.

The story

Launched in 1988 as the Speedmaster Automatic, this model was quickly nicknamed the 'Reduced' by collectors due to its smaller size compared to the 42mm Speedmaster Professional. Its production ran for over two decades, offering a more accessible entry into the Speedmaster family with the convenience of an automatic movement. The core design remained largely unchanged, but the family saw several caliber updates for improved reliability and various special editions before being discontinued around 2009.
